steps.title: Configure Asset Copying for Tesseract eng.traineddata
steps.description: Copy eng.traineddata from tessdata/eng.traineddata or eng.traineddata into context.getFilesDir()/tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata.

steps.title: Update Tesseract Initialization to dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract
steps.description: Probe and initialize dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract.TesseractInitializer and dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract.TesseractOCR via safe reflection.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Method Discovery for Tesseract Text Recognition
steps.description: Invoke TesseractOCR recognition methods and process TesseractResult/TesseractWord objects dynamically.

steps.title: Integrate Unified ZXing Barcode and Tesseract OCR Extraction
steps.description: Run ZXing multi-angle decoding and Tesseract text extraction on preprocessed frames, passing extracted data to parsePrintedProductInfo.

steps.title: Validate Luhn Checksum IMEI Extraction
steps.description: Verify 15-digit Luhn checksum validation for IMEI candidates and map IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 fields.

steps.title: Extract Printed Hardware Specifications
steps.description: Parse brand, model, serial number, color, RAM, and storage parameters from recognized printed box text.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compilation Compatibility
steps.description: Validate traditional standard Java 8 source compatibility with zero missing class dependencies.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Build box-stock-manager APK using dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract OCR integration and ZXing barcode reader.
